# GT Building Solutions

GT Building Solutions (legal/trading names: Garg Trading Company and Gujarat Tiles & Sanitary Depot) is a multi-brand building materials and hardware showroom business serving the Panchkula–Chandigarh–Zirakpur–Mohali tri-city area in Haryana/Punjab/Chandigarh, India. It carries 30+ brands across 7 product categories from two physical showrooms.

## Locations

- Garg Trading Company — Plot No. 1, Industrial Area Phase 1, Panchkula, Haryana 134109. Phone: +91 98140 33573. Carries: hardware, adhesives, panels, paints, power tools, pipes & plumbing.
- Gujarat Tiles & Sanitary Depot — SCO 22-23, Phase 2, Industrial Area, Chandigarh. Phone: +91 92168 66671. Carries: tiles & sanitaryware.

Service areas (delivery and project supply, no separate showroom): Zirakpur, Mohali.

## Product categories

- Kitchen, Furniture & Door Hardware — https://gtbuildingsolutions.in/hardware — brands: Hettich, Godrej, Tunes, Eboo, Blaupunkt, Sleek Kitchens
- Adhesives & Surface Solutions — https://gtbuildingsolutions.in/adhesives — brands: Fevicol, Gresbond, Pidilite, Dr. Fixit, Roff, 3M
- Panels & Gypsum Boards — https://gtbuildingsolutions.in/panels — brands: Gyproc, JB Plastering, Chetak
- Tiles & Sanitary — https://gtbuildingsolutions.in/tiles — brands: Kajaria, Hindware, Kerovit
- Paints & Coatings — https://gtbuildingsolutions.in/paints — brands: Asian Paints, Birla Opus, Nippon Paint, Birla White, ICA
- Power Tools & Equipment — https://gtbuildingsolutions.in/power-tools — brands: DeWalt, CUMI, Havells
- Pipes & Plumbing — https://gtbuildingsolutions.in/pipes-plumbing — brands: Prince Piping, Tata Agrico, Birla HiL
